```plato

    // The fractional part of x: x minus its floor, always in [0, 1). For negative
    // x this is the periodic fraction (e.g. FractionalPart(-0.25) = 0.75), matching Floor.
    FractionalPart(x: IReal): IReal
        => x - x.Floor;
```
